description: This file defines custom Hamcrest matchers for testing OpenMRS objects, including matchers for ID, UUID, and Concept attributes.

classes.name: OpenmrsMatchers
classes.description: Provides custom matchers for OpenMRS objects to facilitate testing with Hamcrest.

methods.name: hasId
methods.description: Returns a matcher that verifies if an OpenmrsObject has the specified ID.

methods.name: hasUuid
methods.description: Returns a matcher that verifies if an OpenmrsObject has the specified UUID.

methods.name: hasConcept
methods.description: Returns a matcher that verifies if a ConceptSearchResult contains a specific Concept.
